test.description: independent: two groups of a grouping variable (variables + group). paired: two measurements of the same cases in two columns (pairs). one_sample: one variable against the value mu.

variables.description: Numeric dependent variables (independent and one_sample); one test each.

group.description: Grouping variable with exactly two levels (independent).

pairs.description: Paired test: rows {first, second}, two numeric columns measured on the same cases (e.g. before and after). The difference is first - second.

mu.description: One-sample test: the value the mean is compared with.

student.description: Student t test (equal variances; for paired/one-sample this is the t test).

welch.description: Welch t test (stats::t.test var.equal = FALSE). Recommended default for two independent groups.

nonparametric.description: Rank test: Mann-Whitney U (independent) or Wilcoxon signed-rank (paired, one sample), with Hodges-Lehmann estimate.

alternative.description: Alternative hypothesis; one-sided only when the direction was fixed before seeing the data.

enabled.description: Effect size with CI (effectsize): Cohen's d (d_z for paired), rank-biserial r for rank tests.

type.description: d = Cohen's d, g = Hedges' g (small-sample corrected); independent groups only.

descriptives.description: Table of n, mean, SD, SE, CI, median and quartiles per group.

normality.description: Shapiro-Wilk per group (independent) or of the differences (paired).

means.description: Individual values with means and confidence intervals.
